title: Manns Search For Mennie 26
author: bpatrick
html: One more page to explain a little bit about what has been happening for the last six pages or so and who this mysterious savior is and then we can put MSFM on hold for a while. I was always under the impression Vivian was everyone’s least favorite story (Josh Sandoval at work called it inexplicably “The Gay-doctor Story”) but apparantly I was wrong.
postClass: post-390 post type-post status-publish format-standard hentry category-mannssearchformeenie uentry post-comic postonpage-1 odd post-author-bpatrick

comments.author: David
comments.html: At the moment it’s a huge cliffhanger, but the kind that should be resolved rather than the kind that shouldn’t. A horrible sinking feeling about how it’s going to end is less satisfying than confirmation thereof, I guess?

comments.author: b.patrick
comments.html: I’m pretty excited to do the next part. I didn’t think I’d be away from it this long. It’s still just getting started, really.

comments.author: steve
comments.html: Don’t you think it’s about time you brought this back? Are you trying to hurt us?

comments.author: AJ
comments.html:
holy fuck this hasnt been updated for 2 years!?
my heart sank when the next> button dissappeared

comments.author: b.patrick
comments.html: Alright steve and AJ, more MSFM comin’ up! Yay! I really like MSFM, it hasn’t gotten much love around here.
